name: rom-studio
description: ROM Studio — inspect original game binaries, understand their assembly, and build for the web

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.dev: npm run compile && node dist/tools/src/cli.js dev
scripts.build: npm run compile && node --max-opt=1 --no-concurrent-sparkplug dist/tools/src/cli.js build
scripts.build:game: npm run compile && node --max-opt=1 --no-concurrent-sparkplug dist/tools/src/cli.js build-game
scripts.preview: npm run compile && node dist/tools/src/cli.js preview
scripts.test: npm run compile && node dist/tools/src/testing/run.js all
scripts.test:unit: npm run compile && node dist/tools/src/testing/run.js unit
scripts.inspect: npm run compile && node dist/tools/src/cli.js inspect
scripts.test:integration: npm run compile && node dist/tools/src/testing/run.js integration
